content: Rise of the blood king Check out documentary on David and Goliath true story  History Vault It starts with the Order Archivist as a young mage  is discussing Aurtus and the legend, the old archivist laughs telling the young mage he knows nothing of Aurtus and invites them to the archive where he tells the story.  “Whatever you think you know about  Aurtus,  forget it, the story has been  drowned  in religion and legends so long that the real story has been long forgotten, except here , as written by the first archivist, the original chronicles exist.” Years after the arrival of humans to earth, those with the ability to harness power are becoming fewer and fewer with each generation, humans are fractured, located in tribes . But one man has risen to try and bring the humans across the continent together again.  Jason has spent his life on his farm, his brother is a powerful mage at the age of 14 and has gone off to  apprentice with the  village’s  mage, leaving  12-year-old  Jason to shoulder the chores of the farm and to escape the beatings of his alcoholic father.  Three years later Jason yearns for something more, having had enough of his father and never wanting to farm for the rest of his life. A man comes through the village, recruiting for a great army, an army to unite the lands under one kingdom. Jason quickly joins up,  before he can leave his father finds  out,  a fight that Jason wins, grabbing his father’s old rusted sword he escapes the farm and joins the army.  Joining a motley  crew  of other  like-minded  villagers and under the command of the would-be  emperor  Solomon  begins to train as a soldier. Soon Solomon sees the young man’s gift of the sword  and brings him under his wing, Jason grows close to Solomon and his son, learning military tactics and combat training he rises through the ranks.  His stock rises as he follows Solomon across the territories, taking one fort after another, bringing the territory to heel in a bloody conquest . Jason soon becomes the second in  command,   but the fatherly love of Solomon  becomes suspicion as Jason is revered as a brilliant military commander overshadowing the  would-be   king’s  own rule.  One night the king sends assassins to kill Jason and he narrowly escapes, realizing what had happened he escapes , In his wanderings he finds the ronin, soldiers of  fortune, some expelled by the very battles led by Jason,  There leader Blackfish is a tan skinned quiet killer  this  is a tense period but Jason soon gains  the warriors  confidence,  Blackfish seeing he is losing his men to Jason, challenges the young man and the two fight for leadership, Jason winning and now in control of the ronin.  Jason convinces them the king needs to be defeated,  he turns to the only power with the ability to stand against the would be  king,  the mysterious warriors of  the shadowlands, a place to the north-east, they are a reclusive people and those who go there, never return. Jason and his 600 mercenaries march a thousand miles .  The people of the ghost coast are not impressed with Jason’s request, but the warlord of these people sees an opportunity and after a loyalty test, gives him another thousand warriors,  the warlord sees if he can break the momentum of Solomon the land will remain divided, allowing for easier pillaging.  Jason  takes the soldiers and crosses back to face the king. In a series of  battles,  he defeats  Solomon,  the ghostly warriors return home, leaving Jason with his 600 mercenaries and a defeated army, instead of disbanding them he goes against his word and continues Solomon’s  quest,  coming to bring the territory under one rule, his rule.  Now that Jason is  king,   he ensures his power base by sending his second in command after  Solomon’s son who is gathering an army in the east to march against Jason.  After many bloody battles Solomon’s son is killed, his head is brought to Jason.  Soon Suspicion and intrigue riddle the new empire, Jason is forced to make decisions that he finds distasteful to protect his power.  Jason’s rule  descends  continuing putting down revolt after revolt, killing lords and peasants, he hangs  their  head from poles outside his castle giving him the name the blood king.  After years of bloody rule, Jason is married and his wife gives him a  son,  they name him Aurtus and soon he is the Joy of his father’s life.  Aurtus grows up a sheltered life within the castle until he is coming to manhood, he has heard the rumors and heard the names people call his gentle and loving  father,  it couldn’t possibly be true. It is not until Jason is finally given a military command and sent out  , during this time he is faced with a decision to slaughter innocent villages and gives the command to fall back, to the shock of his officers, calling Aurtus weak and unable to handle the  decisions  of battle, they decide to do away with the prince, there are those who don’t want a clear heir to succeed Solomon now that he is aging. Aurtus is attacked at night and  manages,  wounded to fight his way free and escapes into the forest, he wakes up in the  enemy’s   hands,  but  their  leader has seen Aurtus command the troops and also his decision to  restrain the troops.  This man begins to show Aurtus who his father is, begins to tell him about the bloody swath his father has cut through the country, Aurtus soon sees the result of his  father’s  rule, the starving people and  experiments  on those found to have mage abilities and he denounces  his father  and decides his father must pay for his crimes.  Aurtus begins to gather his own army,  hunted by assassins and soldiers of his father’s army he continues to draw people to him, finally deciding to march on the castle.  An incredible battle ensures and Jason and Aurtus finally come together after his time away.  His father is cold and angry, this was not the man Aurtus was raised by and he tries to kill him, not able to take him  himself in his advanced age he springs a trap that almost kills Aurtus, but he manages to  maneuver  out of it with the help of his loyal soldiers.  Aurtus is forced to kill his father, He arrests the lords and bring them to justice, hosting a public trial as he opens the overly full food stores to the people and allowing those in the dungeons let go, Aurtus is celebrated as a leader of peace.
